errors.evidence: The description states that the time range is between 2000 and 2020, but the data on the chart extends beyond 2020 to include a final data point for a later year (likely 2021 or 2022).

The final increase for the Austria line is described as a "leichte Steigung" (slight increase). In the chart, this is a very sharp and significant increase from approximately 0.45% to 1.5%, which is not accurately conveyed by the word "leicht" (slight).

This is from the description of the Austria line. The description states that the value rises to 1.5% in the year 2020. However, the chart shows the value for Austria in 2020 is approximately 0.45%. The rise to 1.5% occurs in a year after 2020.

The description states that the value for Germany falls to approximately -0.25% in 2005. According to the chart, the value for Germany in 2005 is clearly positive, at approximately +0.10%. The line never reaches -0.25% at any point.

This is from the description of the Germany line. The description states that the value rises to 1.75% in the year 2020. However, the chart shows the value for Germany in 2020 is approximately 0.3%. The rise to 1.75% occurs in a year after 2020.
